During harvest our standard hours are 8:00am to 7:00pm, seven days a week. Hours may change due to weather. Please check website often for the most up to date hours.
Grain marketing options
Cash or spot price
Haul it in and take the spot price, which is determined at the close of market. Payment will be made within 7 days of delivery.
Forward contract
Lock in a price now for grain you deliver later. Minimum 5,000 bushels, in 5,000 bushel lots.
Storage
Store grain at 5 cents per bushel per month, and sell when you decide the price is right. A 10 cent per bushel load out fee will be charged if corn is pulled back out of storage.
Corn drying and shrink
Shrink: 1.4% per point of moisture above 14%.

Badger Grain Supply, LLC is a licensed Wisconsin grain dealer and grain warehouse keeper, regulated by the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection.
Grain dealer license 302165 GL
Grain warehouse keeper license 302162 GW
Wisconsin requires us to give you these notices in writing. They are reproduced here word for word.
Grain we buy from you · required by s. ATCP 99.14(2)(a), Wis. Adm. Code
IMPORTANT NOTICE
Badger Grain Supply, LLC participates in Wisconsin’s Agricultural Producer Security program. If we fail to pay you for grain when payment is due, you may file a claim under this program. The program may reimburse up to 80% of the first $60,000 of your allowed claim, and up to 75% of any additional amount. For more information, you may contact the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection, 2811 Agriculture Drive, P. O. Box 8911, Madison, WI 53708-8911 (phone 608/224-4998).
Grain we store for you · required by s. ATCP 99.26(2)(a), Wis. Adm. Code
IMPORTANT NOTICE
Badger Grain Supply, LLC participates in Wisconsin’s Agricultural Producer Security program. If we fail to return your grain on demand, you may file a claim under this program. The program may reimburse you for the loss of up to $100,000 worth of grain. For more information, you may contact the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection, 2811 Agriculture Drive, P. O. Box 8911, Madison, WI 53708-8911 (phone 608/224-4998).
These notices are also given to you in writing when you first deliver or store grain with us, and again each license year, as the rule requires.
